title: Quenched Kenyan Tamarind Stew
description: A rich, crumbly, comforting Kenyan dish featuring a tamarind ball, nimono-simmer, and an ovo-vegetarian-friendly twist.
instructions: Heat a tablespoon of oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté the onions until translucent.
Add the diced carrots, sweet potato, and green beans and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, then pour in the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Place the tamarind ball into the pot, break it with a spoon, and let the mixture simmer for 15 minutes.
Crack the egg into a small bowl and whisk; then slowly pour the beaten egg into the stew while stirring to create ribbons.
Stir in the crushed peanuts and coconut milk, and simmer for an additional 5 minutes until the stew thickens slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then remove from heat.
Ladle the stew into bowls, garnish with a sprinkle of peanuts if desired, and serve hot.
